cohort: Sixty pregnant women aged 21-39 years with clinical symptoms of genital herpes (sore-vesicle clusters and minimal ulceration).
finding: Antiviral therapy was effective in reducing HSV viral load as measured by PCR in 91.6% of women with genital herpes.
mod_finding: 40% of women with HSV 1 or HSV 2 had a spontaneous vaginal delivery, while 60% had a cesarean delivery.
